# Writing style

> Short sentences, active voice, no jargon. One idea per paragraph.

## Rule
- Address the reader as "you".
- No superlatives such as "best" or "unique" without proof.
- Numbers as digits, dates as YYYY-MM-DD in notes.

## History
- 2026-02-01 to 2026-05-04: long sentences were allowed in newsletters (replaced, source [[client-feedback-lessons]])
